title: The Dinner Comes Back
sceneText:
When you came down this morning the talking in the kitchen stopped for a moment. By the time you had gone over, the voices were up again.

At midday Martha, in the middle of talking to you, happened to mention the cook over at Thornwall.

{@marta}“That mutton she does, it is the way they do it in Ridgehold,” she said. “Her husband came down from the hills.”

You have not told anybody what you ate last night.

variants.decorous:
In the afternoon Gregor said: “I hear the Baroness saw you to the door yesterday.”

He bent down and went on brushing. That was the third thing he had said this week.
variants.graceless:
In the afternoon the laughter in the kitchen stopped the moment you called.

{@marta}“Were there any orders, sir?” The smile was still on Martha’s face.
